scores.question: Which agreements contain a non-compete clause?
scores.answer:
The following agreements contain non-compete or express restrictions on competing activities:

- **BLACKBOXSTOCKSINC_08_05_2014-EX-10.1-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF** — Section 1.04 prohibits representing or selling competitive products without the company’s written agreement. [BLACKBOXSTOCKSINC_08_05_2014-EX-10.1-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF p. 1]
- **ImineCorp_20180725_S-1_EX-10.5_11275970_EX-10.5_Distributor Agreement.pdf** — Section 3.3 prohibits marketing, selling, distributing, or soliciting orders for competitive products in the territory during the term without prior written consent. [ImineCorp_20180725_S-1_EX-10.5_11275970_EX-10.5_Distributor Agreement.pdf p. 2]
- **MEDALISTDIVERSIFIEDREIT,INC_05_18_2020-EX-10.1-CONSULTING AGREEMENT.PDF** — Section 7.3, “Noncompetition,” restricts ownership of, participation in, and specified services for competitors during the consultancy and for 12 months afterward. [MEDALISTDIVERSIFIEDREIT,INC_05_18_2020-EX-10.1-CONSULTING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 4]
- **LifewayFoodsInc_20160316_10-K_EX-10.24_9489766_EX-10.24_Endorsement Agreement.pdf** — Section 6, “Non-Competing Services,” prohibits similar promotional services or use of the individual’s identity to advertise competing products during the term. [LifewayFoodsInc_20160316_10-K_EX-10.24_9489766_EX-10.24_Endorsement Agreement.pdf p. 2]
- **EcoScienceSolutionsInc_20171117_8-K_EX-10.1_10956472_EX-10.1_Endorsement Agreement.pdf** — Section 8 prohibits endorsements, appearances, or advertisements for directly competitive products during the term and within the territories. [EcoScienceSolutionsInc_20171117_8-K_EX-10.1_10956472_EX-10.1_Endorsement Agreement.pdf p. 3]
- **HealthcentralCom_19991108_S-1A_EX-10.27_6623292_EX-10.27_Co-Branding Agreement.pdf** — Section 9 restricts HCI from supplying content to or engaging with other Canadian portal websites; Section 7 also restricts competitive use of customer data during the term and for six months afterward. [HealthcentralCom_19991108_S-1A_EX-10.27_6623292_EX-10.27_Co-Branding Agreement.pdf p. 5]

- **NETGROCERINC_07_31_1998-EX-10.15-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF** — Restricts Excite from displaying competitor promotions, advertising, content, or online-supermarket offerings, subject to exceptions. [NETGROCERINC_07_31_1998-EX-10.15-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF p. 4]

- **USASYNTHETICFUELCORP_10_21_2010-EX-10.10-STRATEGIC ALLIANCE AGREEMENT.PDF** — Requires exclusive dealing for contemplated transactions and prohibits circumventing the other party through third parties. [USASYNTHETICFUELCORP_10_21_2010-EX-10.10-STRATEGIC ALLIANCE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 13]
- **WaterNowInc_20191120_10-Q_EX-10.12_11900227_EX-10.12_Distributor Agreement.pdf** — Appoints an exclusive territorial distributor, subject to performance benchmarks. [WaterNowInc_20191120_10-Q_EX-10.12_11900227_EX-10.12_Distributor Agreement.pdf p. 3]
